data.cancellation_notes:
## Cancellation Policy

Cancellation requests must be submitted in writing to contact@knotmyboatcharters.com and include your name and charter date.

Refund Schedule:
-30+ days: 25% non-refundable
-15-29 days: 50% non-refundable
-14 days or fewer: 100% non-refundable

## Weather Policy

To prioritize guest safety, Knot My Boat Charters reserves the right to determine whether weather conditions are charterable. Uncharterable conditions may include small craft advisories, high winds, large waves, and severe storms. Light rain, brief passing storms, and cooler temperatures are considered charterable.

> If conditions are deemed uncharterable, a **non-expiring credit** will be issued for the amount paid, excluding catering. This credit may be redeemed toward a future charter.
